items.title: Jack Lesberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: I met Leonard Bernstein there... he says why don't you go and audition for the — he was taking over the City Center Symphony... He actually put me on as Associate Principal when I went with the orchestra, with that City Central Symphony when I went with him.

ctx.x: What was a night of work at Condon’s like? What time did you start?

Well you had to be in pretty good shape to take it you know, because there was plenty of drinking going on there, and smoking cigarettes and what have you. There was a lot of action going on there all the time, but it was fun and all the musicians came in there. And I met Leonard Bernstein there. He loved jazz music. And he used to come in through the back door, underneath door, it was just funny the way the door was, and he got along famously with Eddie. Eddie was just, he was a terrific. They just thought he…
Some of his own work perhaps?
